rule: What a port CARRIES or MEANS when it is not a physical connector; ifc/connectors.json holds the connectors.
slot Protocols: Pset_DistributionPortTypeCable.Protocols (IfcIdentifier list) on the carrying port, whose SystemType is the family's.
slots Codec / Container / MediaFormat / Logic: APK_Signal.<slot> (IFC4X3 has no word for them).
A port typed only by a Logic word is a CAD dataflow node, never an IfcDistributionPort.
Each family's `description` is the one line a palette or picker shows for it.

One protocol, one canonical id (owner, ROAD-3598 answer 9, 2026-11-06). `aliases` are the other spellings that name a format, matched whole with case and white space aside ('Dante / AES67', 'Ravenna / AES67' and 'AES-67' are AES67); a spelling two formats claim names neither. A flow variant the CAD draws (DANTE-TX8, AES67-RX, ST2110-30-RX16 ...) names its protocol in `canonical`, and Pset_DistributionPortTypeCable.Protocols always carries the canonical id.

Hand-kept since ROAD-3588 (2026-11-06): this file is the source. Edit it here, then copy it byte for byte to contracts/python/apkaudio_contracts/ifc/ (npm run gen in contracts) and DATABASE.server.BIM/SRC/bim/data/ifc/ (tools/ifc/vendor_ifc_data.py) and EDITORS.CAD.Like.audio/src/vendor/ifc/. `cad_source` names the CAD file a format was first drawn from (those files are gone).

Audio-Networked.description: Networked audio — Dante, DDM Manager, Q-LAN, AES67 and other audio-over-IP flows; transmitters generate flows (multicast, or unicast for Q-LAN), receivers subscribe.

ST-2110.description: SMPTE ST 2110 professional media over managed IP — essence flows carried on a network interface (not physical connectors)

NMOS.description: AMWA NMOS — discovery, registration and connection management for ST 2110 / IP media nodes

IP-Streaming.description: IP streaming protocols — real-time RTP/RTSP, web streaming (HLS, DASH, CMAF, WebRTC) and broadcast / IPTV transport (multicast, MPEG-TS, SRT, RIST, Zixi).

AV-over-IP.description: AV-over-IP systems — NDI, SDVoE and vendor encoder / decoder platforms carrying video and audio on a LAN. Dante, Dante AV, AES67 and ST 2110 are in their own families.

VoIP.description: VoIP / unified communications signalling — the call set-up protocols; the voice itself is RTP (IP-Streaming) coded with G.711, G.722 or Opus (Codecs-Audio). WebRTC is in IP-Streaming.

MXL.description: EBU DMF Media eXchange Layer — zero-copy media exchange between software media functions (containers) through shared-memory flows, or across hosts over a fabric. Flows are described by NMOS IS-04 Flow JSON and identified by UUID.

SMPTE-Audio.description: SMPTE audio carriage — audio embedded in HD-SDI, non-PCM bitstreams (AC-3, E-AC-3, AAC) inside AES3, and the standard track and channel layouts. Signal formats, not physical connectors.

Codecs-Audio.description: Audio codecs — how audio is coded: uncompressed PCM, lossless (FLAC, ALAC) and lossy (MP3, AAC, Opus, the G.7xx voice codecs). VoIP uses G.711 / G.722 / Opus; streaming AAC / MP3 / Opus.

Codecs-Video.description: Video codecs — legacy (MPEG-1/-2, MPEG-4 Part 2), current (H.264, H.265, AV1 …) and professional / broadcast (JPEG 2000, ProRes, DNx, XAVC …). JPEG XS is ST 2110-22.

Codecs-Container.description: Audio / video containers — the wrappers that hold coded audio, video, subtitles and metadata. MPEG-TS is the container; MPEG-TS-UDP (IP-Streaming) is the transport.

Media-Images.description: Image & Still Graphic Formats — raster, vector, HDR, and RAW photographic media essences.

Media-3D-Doc.description: 3D scene models, documents, and data exchange structures.

Idea.description: IDEA ports — where a value enters a dataflow graph: a concept, an assumption, a parameter or a constant.

Result.description: RESULT ports — where a value leaves a dataflow graph: the answer the wiring computes.

Logic.description: Boolean logic ports — compute true / false from the values wired in. NOT takes one input; the others take two or more.

Arithmetic.description: Arithmetic ports — compute a number from the numbers wired in, or compare two numbers to a true / false.

SMPTE ST 299-1 — 24-bit AES3 audio embedded in HD-SDI (ST 292-1): 4 groups × 4 ch = 16 ch at 48 kHz (8 at 96 kHz), data in C-stream HANC; group data DIDs 2E7h / 1E6h / 1E5h / 2E4h, control 1E3h / 2E2h / 2E1h / 1E0h

SMPTE ST 337 — non-PCM audio / data in AES3: bursts led by Pa/Pb sync (16-bit F872h / 4E1Fh), Pc burst_info, Pd length; channel-status non-audio bit set; frame mode (one burst over both subframes, ≤ 7 streams) or subframe mode (≤ 14)
SMPTE ST 339 — ST 337 generic data types: 0 null, 2 time stamp (stream 7, LTC + sample count), 3 pause, 26 utility (V-sync marker), 30 user-defined
SMPTE ST 340 — AC-3 (Dolby Digital, ATSC A/52) in AES3 via ST 337: data_type 1, one 1536-sample sync frame per burst (32 ms at 48 kHz); AES3 rate must equal the audio rate
SMPTE ST 340 — E-AC-3 (Dolby Digital Plus) in AES3 via ST 337: data_type 16, 1536-frame burst period, frame mode only, 3324-frame (69.25 ms) decode latency
SMPTE ST 2041-2 — MPEG-2 AAC LC / HE AAC in ADTS over AES3 via ST 337: data_type 7, burst every 1024 frames (2048 with SBR)
SMPTE ST 2041-3 — MPEG-4 AAC (data_type 10, 1024 / 960 frames) and HE AAC v1 / v2 (data_type 11, 2048 / 1920) over AES3 via ST 337, in ADTS or LATM / LOAS

SMPTE ST 2035 — audio track cases for recorders and embedded / AES3 I/O: tracks 1/2 = AES pair 1, 3/4 = pair 2 …; e.g. case 11c = 5.1 on T1-6 + stereo T7/8, 11d = 5.1 + Lt/Rt, 11e = 5.1 + ST 337 bitstream on T7/8

AND — true when every input is true

NOT — the opposite of its one input

EQUAL — true when the two inputs are the same number
NOT EQUAL — true when the two inputs differ
LESS THAN — true when the first input is below the second

GREATER THAN — true when the first input is above the second
